headline: Meta lobbied the Luxembourg government before the European Union's AI delay, according to a Luxembourg Times report.
score_reason: Lowered 1 from 5: headline only, so what Meta asked for and when is unverified.
importance_line: It points to company lobbying of a national government before an EU delay on AI, which matters to people who rely on EU AI rules and to the governments setting them; what Meta asked for and whether it changed the outcome is not known.
summary: The Luxembourg Times reports that Meta lobbied the Luxembourg government ahead of the EU's AI delay.
